system.description: Armor Class: 4 Hit Dice: 2 (S) Move: 60' (20') Flying: 180' (60') Attacks: 1 bite or 1 bump or 1 spit Damage: 1d2 or 1d4 or see below No. Appearing: 2d10 (0) Save As: F2 Morale: 5 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 0 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 30 Monster Type: Lowlife (Common). Giant locusts are 2'-3' long and live underground. They may be mistaken for statues (or might not be noticed at all) until approached, because of their stone-gray color.
